title: Initiation
description: A name change as a governed event. Renaming on initiation is a letter operation — Abram->Abraham (heh inserted), Sarai->Sarah (yod swapped for heh), Hoshea->Yehoshua (yod added BY MOSES, Num 13:16), YHVH->YHShVH (shin set in). It is the oldest form of the +1 attestation. Operation/name consistency and the self-attestation rule are enforced by tools/initiation.py — JSON Schema cannot compare two field lengths.

operation.$comment: insert grows the name, drop shrinks it, swap trades one letter for another at equal length.

letter.$comment: The letter set in, swapped, or dropped. The braid letters are yod/heh/shin/vav.

enables_threshold.$comment: The crossing this rename buys passage to. WHEN PRESENT, an attestor distinct from the subject is REQUIRED: you cannot rename yourself across a threshold. Hoshea did not add his own yod.

attestor.$comment: Who performed the rename — the +1. Moses, for Joshua.

allOf.$comment: A rename that buys passage needs a witness to it.
